summary.text: Zach Abbott is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 79, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Air Force veteran, he said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that he grew up in the 79th District.

paragraphs.text: Zach Abbott graduated from South Christian High School and from Calvin University in 2016 with a history degree.

In the survey he said he worked as a library circulation assistant and tutor at Calvin and then at The Right Place, Inc., where he said his research helped attract investment and jobs in West Michigan.
Abbott served in the U.S. Air Force from 2018 to 2024, as a weather forecaster according to his survey answers.
Abbott said he lives in the district with his wife and three children.

He listed his campaign messages as prosperity, opportunity and progress, and said he is most passionate about the economy and policies that help Michigan residents achieve a higher standard of living.
